# Point-in-time documents

Reviews, handoffs, briefs and run reports written between 2026-07-17 and
2026-08-11. They were at the repository root; they are here because a reader
opening the root should see what the project *is*, not a reverse-chronological
pile of what it was thinking on particular afternoons.

**These are frozen. Do not edit them to reflect current state.** Their value is
that they record what was believed on a given date, including the parts that
turned out to be wrong — several of the corrections recorded in `CLAUDE.md`'s
rules are legible only by comparing one of these against what followed. Editing
one to be correct destroys the only evidence that it was ever incorrect.

Where the live version of each thing lives now:

| for | read |
|---|---|
| what is true and what is still open | `GOALS.md` |
| what has been measured, and where the artifact is | `RESULTS_INDEX.md` |
| how to work in this repo | `CLAUDE.md` |
| how a number is allowed to be scored | `SCORING_POLICY.md` |

One dated file deliberately stayed at the root: `LEGACY_ATTRIBUTION_AUDIT_2026-08-05.md`
is regenerated by `audit_legacy_attribution.py` and checked in CI, so it is an
output, not a record.
